𝗔 𝟰𝟬𝟬𝟬 𝗿𝘂𝗽𝗲𝗲 𝗳𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝟳𝟰 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗻𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝘅𝗵𝗮𝘂𝘀𝘁.

Two high school students got tired of waiting for a perfect climate solution.
So they built an imperfect one that works today.
A 3D printed filter with algae that feeds on exhaust carbon dioxide and releases oxygen.
Already on 500 bikes in Indonesia.
Won a major American innovation prize.
Built their own company. All before graduation.
